witness: single witness glass for the whole 99-layer run (witness_reset_layers not set)
reading_of_rate_elargi: the widened native profile of reports/STRAT_Rate_expertise_2026-10-13.md (480 joint window/wavelength neighbours, Rate budget 240 instead of 120, six refinement rounds instead of the mode's default), plus the final Rate refinement of the R5 integration (rate_post_refinement). On r75x0.5 seed 101 the widened profile gave SEEL 0.36006088633539163 nm against 0.3967 nm for the reference (-9.24 %, confirmed on 8 independent groups, 6.331 to 10.494 %); that report also says the own contribution of the joint neighbourhood was not confirmed against the same budgets without it.

final_refinement.what: certus/workers/certus_strat_workers_rate.py::refine_rate_output -> certus/core/certus_strat_rate_post.py::refine_native_output, run after the whole search, on native parents only, no historical plan or anchor injected
final_refinement.preconditions_checked_at_start: consensus enabled, consensus_top_k >= 9, at least 2 consensus seeds (check_rate_post_preconditions, commit 6f200d61): the run refuses to start otherwise
final_refinement.bounds: beam 2, at most 2 passes (internal windows, then prefix), 300 proposals per pass, 600 in total, groups of 9, quota of 73 groups, stops without gain
final_refinement.within_run_pairing: refine_native_output returns the native rows followed by the refined candidates and a ledger (passes[].before/after, best_score, winner): the native result before refinement is therefore in the same run, and the gain of the refinement is read inside it. The refinement runs after the search and does not change it.
final_refinement.explicit_failure: if no native parent holds a complete consensus the ledger status is no_complete_native_parent and nothing is refined; an absence of depositable plan stays an explicit failure with no valid SEEL (docs/ETAT.md A9)
